title.zh: 将莱特省塔纳万市镇基灵描笼涯基灵中学的名称变更为基灵国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Kiling High School in Barangay Kiling, Municipality of Tanauan, Province of Leyte, to Kiling National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Kiling High School in Barangay Kiling, Municipality of Tanauan, Province of Leyte, to Kiling National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Kiling tại Barangay Kiling, Thị trấn Tanauan, Tỉnh Leyte thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Kiling
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Kiling ในบารังไกย์ Kiling, เทศบาล Tanauan, จังหวัด Leyte เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Kiling
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Kiling di Barangay Kiling, Kotamadya Tanauan, Provinsi Leyte menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Kiling
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Kiling di Barangay Kiling, Perbandaran Tanauan, Wilayah Leyte menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Kiling

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7711_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Kiling High School in Tanauan, Leyte, is hereby changed to Kiling National High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
